items.subject: A sun-bleached outback cemetery with rows of weathered headstones in red Pilbara earth
items.action: Afternoon wind moves dry grass between graves, a few of them new, with no mourners present
items.gaze_interaction: The eye travels down the long rows of stones toward the distant ochre ranges
items.setting: Remote Western Australian town cemetery, 1989, low wire fence, scattered dry spinifex
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, faded grey stone, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: A single fresh bunch of wildflowers wilting against a newer headstone
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon daylight, long gentle shadows
items.mood: Still air, long shadows across endless rows, a vast empty sky over the stones
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y nueve ya habían muerto más de quinientos antiguos trabajadores y residentes de Wittenoom.

items.subject: Former Wittenoom miners and residents, Spanish, Italian and Anglo-Australian men and women in their 50s and 60s, thin and stooped
items.action: Gathering in folding chairs for an early meeting of their new support society
items.gaze_interaction: Most seen from behind, heads turned toward a speaker at a trestle table; one gaunt grey-haired Spanish man leans on a cane, shoulders hunched
items.setting: Modest suburban community hall in Perth, 1979, fibro walls, louvred windows, ceiling fans
items.color_palette: Faded cream walls, brown wood floor, muted 1970s mustard and olive clothing
items.props_detail: A portable oxygen cylinder on a trolley beside one chair
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from the back of the hall
items.lighting: soft diffused daylight through louvred windows
items.mood: Rounded backs, slow careful movements, quiet hall under turning fans
items.narration_anchor: Los que seguían vivos se habían juntado diez años antes en la Asbestos Diseases Society of Australia.

items.subject: An Anglo-Australian judge in his 60s, robed and wigged, small at a high timber bench; a gallery of elderly former miners seen from behind
items.action: The judge reads the verdict aloud from a typed page as the gallery sits motionless
items.gaze_interaction: Judge's head bowed to the page; the frail ex-workers lean forward, a Spanish-born woman's hand resting on her husband's shoulder
items.setting: Wood-panelled Perth supreme courtroom, 1988, high ceiling, coat of arms above the bench
items.color_palette: Deep jarrah brown, black robes, grey suits, pale window light
items.props_detail: The typed verdict page under the judge's reading lamp
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the rear of the public gallery
items.lighting: soft daylight from tall side windows with a warm lamp on the bench
items.mood: A hushed panelled room, still backs, light falling across the bench like a release
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y ocho un juez leyó su veredicto: la compañía había mostrado un desprecio continuo, consciente y contumaz por la seguridad y la salud de sus trabajadores.

items.subject: A Spanish-born Australian woman in her early 60s, slight build, grey hair pinned back, in a pale hospital gown
items.action: Lying still as the scanner table slides her into the machine's ring
items.gaze_interaction: Eyes toward the ceiling, arms resting at her sides, small in the large white room
items.setting: Hospital imaging room in Perth, quiet and clinical
items.color_palette: Soft whites, pale blue-grey, a warm wooden door frame
items.props_detail: Her folded cardigan and handbag waiting on a plastic chair by the wall
items.lighting: soft even overhead light, gentle and calm
items.mood: A lone small figure in a pale quiet room, a still body, a routine repeated for years
items.narration_anchor: Mercedes de Juan, que se quedó en Australia, entra en un escáner y después sopla en un tubo.

items.subject: The same Spanish-born woman in her early 60s, slight build, weathered lined face, in a cardigan over a blouse
items.action: Blowing hard into the mouthpiece tube of a lung function test
items.gaze_interaction: Face to the front, cheeks drawn, shoulders lifted with effort, a technician's hand steadying the tube at frame edge
items.setting: Small respiratory clinic room, beige walls, a window onto a eucalyptus tree
items.color_palette: Beige, soft white, muted green through the window
items.props_detail: The spirometer tube and mouthpiece held to her lips
items.lighting: soft window light from one side
items.mood: Shoulders rising with one long breath, calm diffuse light, a quiet ordinary room
items.narration_anchor: «Nos hacen un escáner y una prueba de función pulmonar», dice Mercedes.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings on red earth
items.action: Loose fibres stirring and lifting in a faint breeze
items.gaze_interaction: Focus fixed on the fibres where they meet the red soil
items.setting: Ground of an abandoned Wittenoom yard, red desert soil
items.color_palette: Blue-grey fibre against rust red earth and ochre grit
items.props_detail: A rusted bottle cap half buried among the fibres
items.lens_technique: macro lens, shallow depth of field
items.lighting: soft low sunlight raking across the surface
items.mood: Fine fibres drifting in warm still air, quiet and weightless
items.narration_anchor: Las fibras pueden causar mesotelioma, asbestosis y cáncer de pulmón.

items.subject: Rows of grey steel filing cabinets and stacked manila case folders in an advocacy archive
items.action: Folders overflow the drawers and pile on top of the cabinets, the collection still growing
items.gaze_interaction: Perspective runs down the narrow aisle toward a small window
items.setting: Back room of a support society office in Perth, worn carpet, fluorescent fittings switched off
items.color_palette: Manila buff, grey steel, faded beige walls
items.props_detail: A cardboard box of new folders on the floor not yet filed
items.lighting: soft daylight from one small window at the end of the aisle
items.mood: Dense shelves in a quiet room, dust motes in a single shaft of light
items.narration_anchor: La cuenta oficial se detuvo. «El gobierno dejó de contar en 2.000, pero ahora se calcula que la cifra puede ser superior a los 4.000.

items.subject: Middle-aged Anglo-Australian men and women in their 40s, ordinary builds, waiting in a clinic
items.action: Sitting in a row of chairs waiting to be called for chest examinations
items.gaze_interaction: Seen mostly from behind and in profile; a balding man rests his elbows on his knees, a woman in a cardigan stares toward the window
items.setting: Respiratory clinic waiting room, Perth, vinyl chairs, laminate floor
items.color_palette: Pale green walls, beige vinyl, soft grey
items.props_detail: A large X-ray envelope resting on one man's lap
items.lighting: soft overcast daylight through a wide window
items.mood: Rounded shoulders, slow waiting, flat calm light over a quiet room
items.narration_anchor: Y sigue aumentando», dice Melita Markey. Están enfermando hijos de policías y de maestros que trabajaron en el pueblo.

items.subject: Wittenoom ghost town seen from above
items.action: Sitting abandoned and half-demolished as red dust drifts across empty streets
items.gaze_interaction: The eye moves from the scattered remaining roofs out to the gorge and desert
items.setting: Pilbara desert plain below the Hamersley Range, late abandoned state, bare slabs where houses stood
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered grey roofs, hints of blue tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: Empty concrete house slabs in a grid where homes were removed
items.lighting: soft golden-hour light, long calm shadows
items.mood: Vast silence, a shrinking town in an immense red landscape, gentle warm light
items.narration_anchor: Mientras los enfermos se contaban a sí mismos, el Estado decidió qué hacer con el pueblo: borrarlo.

items.subject: An Anglo-Australian road worker in his 40s, sturdy build, sun-faded work shirt and wide-brimmed hat, seen from behind
items.action: Unbolting the town's name plate from a roadside directional sign
items.gaze_interaction: Facing the sign, arms raised, the blank metal backing exposed beneath
items.setting: Lonely outback highway junction in the Pilbara, June 2007, red earth verge, spinifex
items.color_palette: Faded green sign, red earth, ochre, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: The removed name plate leaning face-down against the sign post
items.mood: A lone figure under a huge sky, a sign gone blank, wind over empty road
items.narration_anchor: Junio de dos mil siete; otras fuentes dicen dos mil seis. Wittenoom es abolido formalmente. Le quitan el nombre a las señales de la carretera y lo sacan de los mapas.

items.subject: A folded Western Australian newspaper on a government office desk
items.action: Lying open to the front-page story of the town's abolition
items.gaze_interaction: Focus on the headline, the rest of the desk soft
items.setting: Perth government office, 2007, timber desk by a window
items.color_palette: Off-white newsprint, warm timber, soft grey
items.props_detail: A cold cup of tea beside the newspaper
items.mood: Calm quiet office, settled light across a printed page
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de «el fin de un período oscuro en la historia de nuestro Estado».

items.subject: An empty parliamentary committee room
items.action: A bound inquiry report lies closed and untouched at the head of the table
items.gaze_interaction: Perspective down the long table toward the single report
items.setting: Western Australian Parliament House committee room, 1992, green leather chairs, timber panelling
items.color_palette: Deep green leather, dark jarrah, pale cream walls
items.props_detail: The bound inquiry report with a faded ribbon marker
items.lighting: soft afternoon daylight through tall windows
items.mood: Pushed-back empty chairs, still air, a quiet room after everyone has left
items.narration_anchor: Quince años antes, en mil novecientos noventa y dos, una investigación parlamentaria había recomendado limpiar los relaves. El gobierno rechazó esas recomendaciones.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings dumps at the mouth of Wittenoom Gorge
items.action: Spreading down the slopes below abandoned mine workings and into the gorge floor
items.gaze_interaction: The eye follows the tailings from the old mine down to the creek
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, red banded rock walls, abandoned mine site, 1992
items.color_palette: Rust red cliffs, ochre, blue-grey tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A rusted ore chute jutting from the cliff above the dumps
items.camera_angle: high angle from the gorge rim
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon light on the gorge walls
items.mood: Immense still gorge, heavy tailings in warm quiet light, no figure in sight
items.narration_anchor: «La minería en los desfiladeros ha dejado una contaminación que solo puede describirse como vergonzosa, incluso para los estándares de la época», dijo Larry Graham.

items.subject: A shallow creek bed downstream of the gorge
items.action: Slow water carrying bluish fibrous sediment across the floodplain toward distant country
items.gaze_interaction: The eye follows the creek winding away into the plain
items.setting: Pilbara creek and floodplain below Wittenoom, river red gums along the banks
items.color_palette: Red earth, pale green gums, blue-grey sediment, soft sky reflection
items.props_detail: Blue-grey fibre caught in a drift of dry leaves at the water's edge
items.lighting: soft morning light with gentle reflections
items.mood: Quiet moving water, calm open plain, a slow drift that does not stop
items.narration_anchor: «Tenemos el deber de impedir una mayor dispersión de los relaves de asbesto», dijo Mark Nevill, por los residentes, por los visitantes, por las generaciones futuras.

items.subject: A padlocked steel gate and barricade across the old road into the town
items.action: Standing closed across the red dirt road as dust blows beneath it
items.gaze_interaction: The road continues beyond the gate toward the empty town on the horizon
items.setting: Pilbara access road, 2016, red earth, spinifex, distant ranges
items.color_palette: Galvanised grey steel, red earth, ochre, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A heavy rusted padlock and chain on the gate
items.mood: A closed gate under an enormous sky, wind and silence beyond it
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil dieciséis, los documentos dicen por qué los relaves siguen donde están: no porque no se pueda, sino por lo que cuesta.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings lifted as a drifting haze over the plain beyond the barricades
items.action: Wind carrying the dust across the open country past the closed road
items.gaze_interaction: The eye follows the haze from an abandoned yard out to the far horizon
items.setting: Edge of abandoned Wittenoom, 2023, a rusted swing-set frame in an empty yard in the foreground
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, blue-grey haze, golden sky
items.props_detail: A rusted swing-set frame standing alone in the empty yard
items.lighting: soft golden-hour light through drifting dust
items.mood: Warm settled light, an empty swing frame, dust moving freely to the horizon
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintitrés, los estudios del Estado sobre hasta dónde llega la contaminación ya estaban desactualizados. Borraron el nombre del mapa. El polvo no leía mapas.
